The '''moon of Ahch-To''' was a [[moon]] that [[orbit]]ed the [[planet]] [[Ahch-To]]<ref name="Last Jedi Junior" /> located in the [[Ahch-To system]] of the [[the galaxy]]'s [[Unknown Regions]].<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition" />

{{Moon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The moon of Ahch-To first appeared in the [[2017]] movie [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']].<ref name="Episode VIII">{{Film|VIII}}</ref> It was first identified in ''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: A Junior Novel]]'', the [[2018]] junior novelization of the film written by [[Michael Kogge]].<ref name="Last Jedi Junior" />
